Bill.BriefDescription: Regulating when candidates may solicit or accept campaign contributions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to contributions for state office; adding a newsection to chapter 42.17 RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 42.17 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: No candidate for state office may solicit or accept contributionsfrom a political committee, a person required to be registered with thecommission as a lobbyist under RCW 42.17.150, or a person meeting thedefinition of a lobbyist's employer under RCW 42.17.020 during theperiod beginning on the thirtieth day before the date a regularlegislative session convenes and continuing thirty days past the dateof final adjournment, and during the period beginning on the date aspecial legislative session convenes and continuing through the datethat session adjourns.
